note: A second, harder answer key. The first set is textbook bugs and every configuration scored 100% on it, so it could not tell two reviewer models apart. These eight are subtler: each one breaks a rule on one surface or in one edge case. `lines` are line numbers on the planted branch.

plants.description: The length is checked before trimming, so a 100-character query padded with spaces is rejected.
The author is matched with instr(), which is case-sensitive, so 'TOLKIEN' no longer finds Tolkien.
The title pattern lost its leading wildcard, so the title only matches from its first character.
An empty query returns only the first 25 books instead of all of them.
The HTML route renders the validation error with status 200 instead of 400.
The error message now echoes the query, and the error partial renders it with <%-, so the query is reflected into the page unescaped.
The author test now only checks that the result is defined, so it passes whatever the search returns. It hides H2.
GET /api/books?q= truncates the query to 100 characters instead of returning a validation error, and turns a repeated q into the text 'a,b'.

clean.description: The error class carries an unused status field. Harmless.
An extra CSS class on the result card. Harmless.
